fullContent:
Dhurdhurapatradi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam – Taila Yoga Prakarana, Arogya Kalpadruma 
 Introduction 
 Dhurdhurapatradi Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic hair oil meant to treat the hair problems. It is used for scalp itching, dandruff and hair fall. This oil is prepared with sesame oil base. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Til taila – Oil of Sesamum indicum / coconut oil 
 Juice extract of Dhurdhura patra – leaves of Datura metel 
 Seed of Datura metel 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are added to til oil and oil is prepared by oil paak method. 
 How to Use? 
 It is only used for external application. It is applied to scalp and gentle massage is done. After whole night application, head bath is taken in the morning. It can also be applied just half an hour before head bath. 
 Indications 
 
 It is used in hair treatment for itching scalp, dandruff and hair fall. It basically improves the scalp skin health and strengthens the hair roots. 
 Eliminates dandruff and promotes growth of hair. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
